title: Had a really intense visit last night
content: My phone was broken and i had to go on the run with my dog because i had committed some offense. The last time they were after me they shot me and my mom in my bed while we were hiding. I had to watch and didnt wake up until everyone else in the room had died. I woke up a mess to a dark room. Immediately started bawling and panicking- thank god my friend picked up the phone to spend some time with me. I have been going to mallword most nights and i am so tired. Just wanted to share where i know people can relate.
